name: Dankira!!! - Boys, be DANCING! -
original_name: ダンキラ!!! - Boys, be DANCING! -
source:
"Dance to battle!"

In a world where everyone knows how to dance and loves doing it, "Dankira", a competition mixing dance and "killer tricks" (special moves performed by the contestants), is the hottest thing yet!

Dankira is a form of entertainment, designed so that the ones who do a better job of capturing the audience are crowned winners. People from all around the world aspire to be as charismatic as its contestants, not to mention becoming the next winners themselves and as they form groups and find worthy rivals, they keep the competition going strong...

This is the story of but a few young men, who have dedicated themselves to the art of Dankira.
Enter a school for aspiring Dankira masters - Benizuru Academy, which comprises a junior and senior high school. Thousands of students sometimes compete against, other times work with each other to train their dancing skills. You're studying to become a dance coach, and whether it's time for practice or to wind down, you want to help these guys be the best dancers they can be.

Now, it's time to watch them give it their all out there!

[Translated from [url=https://www.konami.com/games/dankira/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“跳舞来战斗！”

在一个人人都会跳舞并且喜欢跳舞的世界里，“Dankira”，一种混合​​舞蹈和“杀手技巧”（参赛者表演的特殊动作）的比赛，是迄今为止最热门的事情！

Dankira是一种娱乐形式，旨在让那些在吸引观众方面做得更好的人成为获胜者。来自世界各地的人们都渴望像参赛者一样具有魅力，更不用说自己成为下一个获胜者，当他们组成团体并找到有价值的对手时，他们就会使比赛保持强劲……

这是几个致力于Dankira艺术的年轻人的故事。
进入一所为有抱负的团克罗大师而设的学校——红鹤学院，该学院由初中和高中组成。成千上万的学生有时互相竞争，有时互相合作训练他们的舞蹈技巧。你正在学习成为一名舞蹈教练，无论是练习还是放松，你都想帮助这些人成为最好的舞者。

现在，是时候看他们全力以赴了！

[翻译自[url=https://www.konami.com/games/dankira/]官网[/url]]
